summary: Gray Media announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.08 per share on common and Class A common stock, payable June 30, 2026 to holders of record June 15, 2026. The Board authorized this recurring capital return via an 8-K filing with press release. No special event or strategic change is attached; the filing solely details the dividend declaration. This represents a routine capital return to shareholders. Investors should watch for future dividend declarations and any shifts in payout policy, though no arbitrage angle is present.
